title: Sodium-Channelopathies-ASD-DEE v1.0.0: code and derived data for 'Cell-type-specific biophysical modeling reveals modifier-dependent phenotypic divergence in sodium channelopathies: a computational framework for the autism-epilepsy spectrum'
description: Reproducible multiscale biophysical and transcriptomic modeling pipeline (Python) resolving how identical mutations in voltage-gated sodium channels (SCN1A, SCN2A, SCN8A) produce divergent neurodevelopmental phenotypes spanning autism spectrum disorder (ASD), intellectual disability, and developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEE). Integrates modified Hodgkin-Huxley conductance formalisms, empirical transcriptomic stoichiometries from The Human Protein Atlas (tissue nTPM and single-cell nCPM), ontogenetic trajectories from BrainSpan, and epistatic modifier gene interactions (Gabra2 and Cacna1g). Derived data, results tables, and figures CC BY 4.0.
